title: Drugs Dataset
description: Offgrid drugs feed with street stock formulas and procedural generation options.
author: Hendo

street_stock.Description: Common street drugs from the Cyberpunk 2020 Corebook.

synthcoke.name: SynthCoke
synthcoke.effects: Stimulant high; paranoia and psychological addiction
synthcoke.description: The second-generation synthetic replacement for cocaine. Like the original, its side effects are nasty: paranoia and psychological addiction.

stim.name: Stim
stim.description: Stim increases endurance, allowing the user to stay alert for longer periods. Side effects include mental delusions.

syncomp_15.name: Syncomp 15
syncomp_15.description: Syncomp is a broad-spectrum poison antidote used to treat nerve and biotoxins. REF is reduced at the rate of 1 point per dose.

speedheal.name: Speedheal
speedheal.description: Speedheal is designed to enhance the natural healing processes. Side effects reduce REF by 1D6/3 for one week after use.

boost.name: Boost
boost.description: Boost increases INT by +1 for a 2-7 hour period. A Boost addict who has gained full tolerance can no longer increase INT and must have more Boost within twelve hours or suffer screaming fits and hallucinations.

blue_glass.name: Blue Glass
blue_glass.description: Blue Glass was originally developed as a biological weapon. Under stress, there is a 3 in 10 chance of flashing out and staring blankly at the pretty colors in your mind. Reduce INT by 1 per dose.

smash.name: Smash
smash.description: Smash is 2020's answer to alcohol. It is yellow, foamy, comes in cans, and makes you loose, happy and ready to party. Withdrawal can trigger suicidal episodes and total catatonia.

dorph.name: 'Dorph
dorph.description: Designed as a combat drug and painkiller, endorphins reduce pain and stress. 'Dorph lets you reduce the effects of stun or shock, but it damages the nervous system: each use adds one extra 1D10 roll; on a 1, the user permanently loses 1 REF.

black_lace.name: Black Lace
black_lace.effects: Euphoria, adrenal rush and pain invulnerability
black_lace.description: A high-powered version of 'Dorph that imparts euphoria, an adrenal rush and invulnerability to pain. CL rises by 2 and the user resists stun or shock. Failed addiction can cause EMP loss and cyberpsychosis.

riskOptions.label: Psychological Addiction
riskOptions.rule: The character must roll under CL each hour after the last dose. Failure causes extreme anxiety, fear and depression and drives the character to seek more of the drug. Kicking the addiction requires a Very Difficult Endurance check and as much time as the Referee decides.

riskOptions.label: Physiological Addiction
riskOptions.rule: The character must roll under BT each hour after the last dose. Failure causes intense pain and 2D6 damage each hour until the habit is kicked with a Very Difficult Endurance check.

riskOptions.label: Death
riskOptions.rule: Each use requires a Death Save with a negative modifier equal to the drug's Strength minus one.

riskOptions.label: Reduced REF
riskOptions.rule: Reduces REF by 1 point per dose for the duration; the penalty is cumulative if another dose is taken before the last wears off.

riskOptions.label: Reduced INT
riskOptions.rule: Reduces INT by 1 point per dose for the duration; the penalty is cumulative if another dose is taken before the last wears off.

riskOptions.label: Tremors
riskOptions.rule: Causes painful tremors in the hands and face and applies -2 REF.

riskOptions.label: Hallucinations
riskOptions.rule: Causes hallucinations of colors, voices and strange shapes. As a hallucinogen side effect, the character always has recurring visions at the Referee's discretion.

riskOptions.label: Paranoia
riskOptions.rule: Causes paranoid delusions. The character must devote all actions to defending against the perceived threat, as decided by the Referee.

riskOptions.label: Delusions
riskOptions.rule: The character believes false realities and must devote all actions to maintaining the delusion, as decided by the Referee.

riskOptions.label: Sterility
riskOptions.rule: Causes permanent sterility on a 3 in 10 chance.

riskOptions.label: Carcinogenic
riskOptions.rule: Has a 3 in 10 chance of causing cancer. If cancer develops, the character takes 1 point of permanent damage unless cured with a Very Difficult Medical Tech check.

riskOptions.label: Psychotic Rage
riskOptions.rule: May cause a psychotic rage in which the character attacks anyone within range.

riskOptions.label: Aggressive Behavior
riskOptions.rule: Makes the character irritable and aggressive, with a 5 in 10 chance of starting a fight with the nearest person.

riskOptions.label: Irrational Fear
riskOptions.rule: Causes irrational fear of everything. The character drops everything and cowers in near catatonia until the drug wears off.

riskOptions.label: Nerve Degeneration
riskOptions.rule: Causes severe nerve damage and permanently reduces REF by 2.

formula.notes: Side effects use negative points and reduce build difficulty; duration applies as multiplier.

warnings: Drugs are dangerous and can permanently damage attributes.
Side effects lower a drug's creation difficulty.
Final street cost is 25 eb per point of final creation difficulty.
